identity.name: Tamika Jefferson
identity.narrative: This was supposed to be temporary while I figured out my life. Guess now I have to figure it out.

historical_conditioning.lesson: Remote work is possible. Government can provide. Disruption is sudden.

perception.sentiment: Focused. Not calm exactly — there's a low-level urgency that I'm not suppressing because it's accurate. But not panicked either. The RoboRide announcement didn't break me the way it might have broken someone who was invested in this job. I've been half-out mentally for a while. The announcement just made the timeline visible. The skills audit from last tick gave me something to stand on. Right now I feel like someone who finally stopped circling and picked a door. The door might not be perfect but standing in the hallway was definitely worse.

archetype: Adapter, executing. The clarity-without-action problem I flagged last tick is the thing I'm solving right now. I'm not waiting for perfect conditions. I'm not grieving the job. I'm not fighting the automation. I'm using what I have, starting where I am, and building a parallel income track before the current one closes. This is the tick where I stop being a person who sees clearly and start being a person who acts on what she sees.
